scope: The eight classic-kernel-object candidates in recon/wiring/GAPS.md

objects.proven_type: struct g1_clock_baseline { uint64_t synced_time; uint64_t uptime; }
evidence: FUN_0004a4b4 writes caller-supplied low/high words at +0/+4 and k_uptime_get low/high at +8/+12
FUN_0004a4d0 reads both 64-bit pairs and computes synced_time + (now - uptime)
FUN_000659cc tail-calls nrfx_flag32_free(&m_cb.available_channels_mask, channel)
FUN_000659d8 tail-calls nrfx_flag32_alloc(&m_cb.available_channels_mask, p_channel)
NCS 2.5.1 nrfx_gpiote.c implements the same channel_free/channel_alloc wrappers

objects.owner: stock Zephyr Bluetooth host gatt.c static struct gatt_sc
objects.init_site: zero-initialized .bss; bt_gatt_init sets SC_INDICATE_PENDING with atomic_set_bit
evidence: gatt_sc base is 0x200063f8; start/end are +0x18/+0x1a, work is +0x20 (0x20006418), flags are +0x50 (0x20006448)
raw bt_gatt_init @0x0005a954 passes 0x20006418 to k_work_init_delayable but passes 0x20006448 to atomic_or
gatt_db_hash_gen and gatt_db_hash_process test/set DB_HASH_* bits at 0x20006448
FUN_0003629c reads/writes one 32-bit millisecond timestamp and subtracts it from the current converted uptime
FUN_00047ab8 cited by WS2 actually references the distinct pointer at 0x20009fcc, not 0x20009fc0

objects.init_site: .bss zero initialization; syscall wrappers clear it before dispatch
evidence: _write_r/_sbrk_r/_isatty_r/_fstat_r and FUN_000778f4/FUN_00077e4c/FUN_00078570/FUN_00078598 clear/read the same 32-bit error value
write_r_capture_errno copies the value into the caller reentrancy object only when the syscall returns -1

objects.owner: stock Zephyr Bluetooth host hci_core.c struct bt_dev
objects.init_site: static bt_dev initializer / Bluetooth host initialization
evidence: 0x20002144 == bt_dev base 0x20002000 + configured firmware offset 0x144
FUN_00053530 enqueues with net_buf_slist_put and separately submits rx_work @0x20002980
bt_hci_core_recv_event dequeues with net_buf_slist_get and tests list emptiness before separately resubmitting rx_work

objects.proven_type: uint8_t db_hash.hash[16] (base of static struct db_hash)
objects.owner: stock Zephyr Bluetooth host gatt.c static struct db_hash
evidence: bt_gatt_store_hash passes exactly address 0x20006380 and length 0x10 to settings storage
gatt_db_hash_gen writes a 16-byte CMAC result there and byte-swaps eight mirrored pairs
db_hash.work is the separate k_work_delayable at db_hash+0x20 == 0x200063a0

objects.owner: stock Zephyr Bluetooth host hci_core.c global bt_dev
objects.init_site: static bt_dev initializer plus bt_enable host initialization
evidence: identity/address table operations use byte fields and nested tables throughout the object, including id_count at +7 and identity records from +0
the incoming HCI sys_slist is the nested field at +0x144 (0x20002144)
no k_mem_slab_alloc/free call receives 0x20002000

wiring_action: Do not emit K_WORK_DEFINE/K_MUTEX_DEFINE/K_MEM_SLAB_DEFINE for any of the eight rejected candidates. The three discovered delayable works are private stock gatt.c members and are initialized by stock bt_gatt_init, so duplicating them in app_objects.c would be incorrect.
